name: VR 2048
summary:
Play the classic viral 2048 game but now in 3 dimensions.  Move blocks around the board to combine similar blocks to create higher and higher numbers until you reach 2048 and beyond.

Play again and again to attain the highest score or fastest time to 2048.  Select levels with varying difficulty for increasing challenge.  Use the timer to setting to race against the clock.  Choose from various block configurations for greater and more engaging challenges.
